style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright daylight
subject: ONE herring in a seller apron, silver blue, big round eye, fins as hands
second_characters: ONE crab buyer fighting him for the roe every beat, claw huge at the lens; ONE shrimp crossing the lens

props.big: ONE open glass jar packed with orange roe, carried in his fins
props.small: ONE tiny glass jar, exactly three roe beads in it
props.card: ONE price card, 1499 in four figures of one height in a row, flat to the lens

environment: a stall in a wall of kelp and crates filling the frame top and bottom, shoals and scales blowing through
lighting: bright white daylight in clear turquoise water, cyan edge left, amber fill right
motion_rule: the frame is TALL and the hero fills at least half its height in EVERY beat, his head never under a quarter of it, always within a fin of the lens. The camera never stops: it orbits him on a hard arc, a new shot size every beat, medium to close, the crates and kelp sweeping the full frame width behind him. He carries what he holds and throws his whole body the full frame width, never fiddling with a prop in place. ONE hero action per beat.

audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, never repeated, speech ends at 7.35, then glass carries it
audio.lip_sync: mouth to the lens, opening on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: in-FLYA-tsi-ya, FI-cha, pri-spo-SO-bi-lis, zu-BOK, od-NOY, PRAZD-ni-kam

timeline.a: hauls the open jar of roe the full frame width at the lens, the camera carving round him; the crab rips at it
swings that jar over his head, roe piling at the glass; the crab hauls his fin down
drives the open jar out past the stall front, head filling the frame, crates sweeping behind; the crab cuts across the lens after him
whips the jar up over the lens, beads blazing across it; the crab drags a crate through the shot
drives his mouth at the lens through flying lids; the crab snaps its claw across the glass
the shrimp throws him the tiny jar and he catches it on the swing, three beads plain inside; the crab lunges after it
the shrimp slaps the price card flat on that tiny jar and he hoists it the full frame width at the lens; the crab snaps under it
hurls the emptied big jar out of frame and swings the tagged one up, crates rushing; the crab grabs at the throw
the crab snaps at the tagged jar and he yanks it the full frame width, head a third of the frame
the shrimp crosses the glass, he turns the tagged jar face on, three beads plain, kelp sweeping
drives the tagged jar into the lens, three beads inside, the card flat to the glass; the claw closes on empty

must_appear: the tall frame filled top and bottom in every beat; the hero fills half its height start to end; at 5.25 three beads are plain inside the tiny jar; at 6.05 the card marked 1499 is slapped flat on it, the number whole, never cropped; at 9.30 he drives it at the lens
negative_prompt: printed sentences, cyrillic words, spoken digits, superscript digits, subtitles, watermark, speech bubble, a second tiny jar, letterbox, a horizontal 16:9 picture, night, dark scene, studio lighting, a prop worked in place, a hero held in one pose, parked camera, push in, motionless or empty background, wide shot, a small distant hero, a cut to another location, the hero's back to the camera, a motionless first or last second, a line said twice, speech after 7.35, offscreen narration, English speech, a second herring
